description: A shell script for testing the behavior of 'git merge --abort' under various scenarios, including conflicts, clean merges, dirty index or worktree states, and completed merges. It sets up a repository, performs different merges, and verifies the correctness of the abort operation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks for success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the output contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific file or path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or contents, asserts they are identical.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Outputs the diff of current changes, used for verification.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
